what: While the 300svh panel stays stuck to the screen, the scroll share is filtered through a spring (stiffness 100 · damping 30) and that share picks one video frame (24fps) — the title rises 24px and fades over 0~25%, the status pill drops in from 16px above and turns on over 28~38%, and the progress ring fills over 28→78%. At each set share (36 · 44 · 52 · 60 · 68%) one label appears in turn — the dot turns on at .025 share with the ring spreading .6→2.4x (.09), a line is drawn from the dot to the label slot (.01→.055), the label stands up .96→1 (.055→.1), and the check is drawn while the circle fills from pale gray to ink (.065→.1). When everything is locked, the pill expands into ”Done + button” over .45s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) and the text swaps with 4px blur and a 10px upward shift over .4s. The checklist below brightens .35→1 per share

options.fps: Number of frames to split the video into (per second), default 24
options.stiffness · damping: Spring that filters scrolling, default 100 · 30 — higher damping slides less
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: 16:9 slot holding the video and name tags (required). Name tag coordinates are % of this slot
options.[data-fx-part=video]: Video stepped through by scroll (optional) — muted playsinline, paused at first
options.[data-fx-part=callout]: One label tag. The text becomes the tag text, with data-start (the share it lights up), data-side (left|right), data-x · data-y (point %), data-ly (tag vertical %), data-ox (horizontal % where the tag attaches, ±12), data-name (name in the check list, first word if absent)
options.[data-fx-part=status] > [data-fx-part=st: Status pill (optional) — the user sets position (relative·absolute). Inside, [data-fx-part=ring] (pathLength 1 circle), if present, is the progress ring. data-state=off|busy|done is attached and fx:state fires. Width follows the text width, but animates .45s only when switching between building ↔ done
options.[data-fx-part=checks]: If left blank, each label gets its own check field (optional)
options.--fx-on · --fx-off: Check circle fill color · initial color, default --kf-ink · --kf-accent-soft
